subject.title: Subagent sessions persist after completion, main session becomes unresponsive

question: Should completed run-mode subagent sessions be retained as visible history by default, automatically hidden/archived/deleted, or separated into explicit history versus active surfaces?
rationale: Current source and tests deliberately preserve keep-mode run subagents, while the issue reports that retained state misleads status/session surfaces and can affect parent responsiveness; changing this default is a user-visible session-history contract decision.

options.title: Retain History, Hide From Active Surfaces
options.body: Keep completed child transcripts by default, but make session/task/Control UI/WebChat projections immediately mark terminal children non-blocking and out of active/default lists unless history is requested.

options.title: Auto-Archive Completed Runs
options.body: Archive or hide completed one-shot subagent sessions after terminal cleanup by default, accepting a retention behavior change that needs docs and upgrade proof.

options.title: Keep Current Retention Contract
options.body: Preserve visible keep-mode rows and handle only narrower quota, stale-task, or lane-starvation bugs in separate trackers.

recommendation.title: Retain History, Hide From Active Surfaces
recommendation.body: Keep completed child transcripts by default, but make session/task/Control UI/WebChat projections immediately mark terminal children non-blocking and out of active/default lists unless history is requested.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision cuts across recent subagent spawn behavior, session-list semantics, and user-visible product behavior where steipete has the strongest verified path history.
